map.计算单样本 t 统计量，检验样本均值与假设均值的差异。: Computes the one-sample t statistic to test the difference between the sample mean and a hypothesized mean.
map.t = (x̄ − μ₀) / (s / √n)；自由度 df = n − 1: t = (x̄ − μ₀) / (s / √n); degrees of freedom df = n − 1
map.单样本 t 统计量衡量样本均值 x̄ 偏离假设总体均值 μ₀ 的程度，以标准误: The one-sample t statistic measures how far the sample mean x̄ departs from the hypothesized population mean μ₀ using the standard error s/√n as yardstick. A larger |t| means stronger evidence that the sample mean differs from the hypothesized value, and df = n − 1 is used to look up critical values of the t distribution. The raw difference x̄ − μ₀ is reported as well.
map.|t| 越大，拒绝原假设的证据越强。: The larger |t| is, the stronger the evidence against the null hypothesis.
map.输出 t 值与自由度。: Outputs the t value and the degrees of freedom.
map.|t|<t临界(0.05,24)=2.064 → 不拒绝原假设（差异不显著）。: |t| below the critical value t(0.05,24)=2.064 means the null hypothesis is not rejected (the difference is not significant).
map.t 与 p 关系？: How do t and p relate?
map.t 越大、|t| 越超临界，p 越小；由 t、df 唯一确定 p。: The further |t| exceeds the critical value, the smaller p becomes; t and df determine p uniquely.
map.自由度为何 n−1？: Why is df equal to n−1?
map.估计 s 用掉 1 个自由度（x̄），故 df=n−1。: Estimating s consumes one degree of freedom (through x̄), leaving df=n−1.
